actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in Facebook Lead Ads (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own Facebook Lead Ads action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your Facebook Lead Ads connection OAuth scopes: Scopes ads_management, leads_retrieval, pages_manage_ads, pages_manage_metadata, pages_read_engagement, pages_show_list, business_management
